content: LangGraph.js offers two handoff implementations: single-agent-with-middleware (state variable like currentStep drives prompt/tool switching, simpler, recommended default) vs multi-agent-subgraphs (distinct nodes, explicit Command(goto, update, graph=Command.PARENT) message passing, use only for bespoke agent implementations). Selective message passing recommended over full subgraph history dump to avoid receiving agent confusion and token bloat.
